ValidationRule.description: Closing Reason must be set before a Lead can be marked Closed Won or Closed Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed Lost")), ISBLANK(TEXT(Closing_Reason__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(IsConverted)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closing Reason is required when the Lead is Closed Won or Closed Lost.
